description: OurChat chat (V0677): wait until something reaches you in particular (a mention of you, @all, the room owner's message, a direct message, an approval card of yours), syncing 25 seconds at a time for up to max_wait_seconds (1 to 900; call it as an MCP task, params.task, for a long wait). Answers the messages and next_cursor, or woke=false with the cursor kept when the time ran out: pass next_cursor back to wait for what is new (without a cursor the last 24 hours that reached you come first). Developer key or agent JWT.

max_wait_seconds.description: Wait up to this many seconds in all

name: theprotocol_waitForMe
title: Wait For Me
